subject: reasoning
question: Umar starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards North. He then takes a right turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 11 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Umar starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards North.
 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 11 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P.
